title: Improving Infinitely Deep Bayesian Neural Networks with Nesterov's Accelerated Gradient Method
summary: As a representative continuous-depth neural network approach, stochastic differential equation (SDE)-based Bayesian neural networks (BNNs) have attracted considerable attention due to their solid theoretical foundations and strong potential for real-world applications. However, their reliance on numerical SDE solvers inevitably incurs a large number of function evaluations (NFEs), resulting in high computational cost and occasional convergence instability. To address these challenges, we propose a Nesterov-accelerated gradient (NAG) enhanced SDE-BNN model. By integrating NAG into the SDE-BNN framework along with an NFE-dependent residual skip connection, our method accelerates convergence and substantially reduces NFEs during both training and testing. Extensive empirical results show that our model consistently outperforms conventional SDE-BNNs across various tasks, including image classification and sequence modeling, achieving lower NFEs and improved predictive accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出一种Nesterov加速梯度增强的SDE-BNN模型，通过整合NAG和NFE相关的残差跳跃连接，显著减少函数评估次数并加速收敛。
AI.motivation: 基于随机微分方程的贝叶斯神经网络虽然理论扎实、应用潜力强，但依赖数值SDE求解器会导致大量函数评估，计算成本高且收敛不稳定。
AI.method: 将Nesterov加速梯度整合到SDE-BNN框架中，并加入NFE相关的残差跳跃连接，加速收敛并减少训练和测试时的函数评估次数。
AI.result: 在图像分类和序列建模等多种任务上，该模型始终优于传统SDE-BNNs，实现了更低的NFEs和更高的预测准确率。
AI.conclusion: 提出的NAG增强SDE-BNN模型有效解决了传统方法计算成本高和收敛不稳定的问题，在保持理论优势的同时显著提升了实际性能。

title: Fair regression under localized demographic parity constraints
summary: Demographic parity (DP) is a widely used group fairness criterion requiring predictive distributions to be invariant across sensitive groups. While natural in classification, full distributional DP is often overly restrictive in regression and can lead to substantial accuracy loss. We propose a relaxation of DP tailored to regression, enforcing parity only at a finite set of quantile levels and/or score thresholds. Concretely, we introduce a novel (${\ell}$, Z)-fair predictor, which imposes groupwise CDF constraints of the form F f |S=s (z m ) = ${\ell}$ m for prescribed pairs (${\ell}$ m , z m ). For this setting, we derive closed-form characterizations of the optimal fair discretized predictor via a Lagrangian dual formulation and quantify the discretization cost, showing that the risk gap to the continuous optimum vanishes as the grid is refined. We further develop a model-agnostic post-processing algorithm based on two samples (labeled for learning a base regressor and unlabeled for calibration), and establish finite-sample guarantees on constraint violation and excess penalized risk. In addition, we introduce two alternative frameworks where we match group and marginal CDF values at selected score thresholds. In both settings, we provide closed-form solutions for the optimal fair discretized predictor. Experiments on synthetic and real datasets illustrate an interpretable fairness-accuracy trade-off, enabling targeted corrections at decision-relevant quantiles or thresholds while preserving predictive performance.

AI.tldr: 提出回归任务中人口统计均等(DP)的松弛方法，通过在有限分位数或阈值上施加约束，而非整个分布，以平衡公平性与准确性
AI.motivation: 在回归任务中，完全分布的人口统计均等(DP)通常过于严格，会导致显著的准确性损失。需要一种更灵活的公平性约束方法，能够在特定决策相关的分位数或阈值上实现公平，同时保持预测性能。
AI.method: 提出(ℓ,Z)-公平预测器，在有限的分位数水平或得分阈值上施加群体CDF约束。通过拉格朗日对偶公式推导最优公平离散预测器的闭式解，并开发基于两个样本(标记样本学习基础回归器，未标记样本校准)的模型无关后处理算法。
AI.result: 理论分析表明离散化成本随网格细化而消失，风险差距趋近于连续最优解。实验在合成和真实数据集上展示了可解释的公平性-准确性权衡，能够在决策相关的分位数或阈值上进行针对性修正，同时保持预测性能。
AI.conclusion: 提出的回归任务中DP松弛方法提供了一种灵活且可解释的公平性框架，允许在特定分位数或阈值上实现公平约束，避免了完全分布DP的过度限制性，在保持预测准确性的同时实现有意义的公平性改进。

title: Practical Efficient Global Optimization is No-regret
summary: Efficient global optimization (EGO) is one of the most widely used noise-free Bayesian optimization algorithms.It comprises the Gaussian process (GP) surrogate model and expected improvement (EI) acquisition function. In practice, when EGO is applied, a scalar matrix of a small positive value (also called a nugget or jitter) is usually added to the covariance matrix of the deterministic GP to improve numerical stability. We refer to this EGO with a positive nugget as the practical EGO. Despite its wide adoption and empirical success, to date, cumulative regret bounds for practical EGO have yet to be established. In this paper, we present for the first time the cumulative regret upper bound of practical EGO. In particular, we show that practical EGO has sublinear cumulative regret bounds and thus is a no-regret algorithm for commonly used kernels including the squared exponential (SE) and Matérn kernels ($ν>\frac{1}{2}$). Moreover, we analyze the effect of the nugget on the regret bound and discuss the theoretical implication on its choice. Numerical experiments are conducted to support and validate our findings.

AI.tldr: 首次为带正nugget的实用EGO算法建立了累积遗憾上界，证明其对常用核函数具有次线性遗憾，是一种无遗憾算法。
AI.motivation: 尽管带正nugget的实用EGO算法在实践中被广泛采用且经验上成功，但迄今为止尚未建立其累积遗憾的理论界限，需要填补这一理论空白。
AI.method: 分析实用EGO（高斯过程代理模型+期望改进采集函数+正nugget）的累积遗憾上界，特别针对平方指数核和Matérn核（ν>1/2），并研究nugget对遗憾界的影响。
AI.result: 首次证明了实用EGO具有次线性累积遗憾上界，因此对常用核函数是一种无遗憾算法，并通过数值实验验证了理论发现。
AI.conclusion: 实用EGO具有理论保证的次线性遗憾性能，nugget的选择对遗憾界有理论意义，为实际应用提供了理论依据。

title: A Distribution-to-Distribution Neural Probabilistic Forecasting Framework for Dynamical Systems
summary: Probabilistic forecasting provides a principled framework for uncertainty quantification in dynamical systems by representing predictions as probability distributions rather than deterministic trajectories. However, existing forecasting approaches, whether physics-based or neural-network-based, remain fundamentally trajectory-oriented: predictive distributions are usually accessed through ensembles or sampling, rather than evolved directly as dynamical objects. A distribution-to-distribution (D2D) neural probabilistic forecasting framework is developed to operate directly on predictive distributions. The framework introduces a distributional encoding and decoding structure around a replaceable neural forecasting module, using kernel mean embeddings to represent input distributions and mixture density networks to parameterise output predictive distributions. This design enables recursive propagation of predictive uncertainty within a unified end-to-end neural architecture, with model training and evaluation carried out directly in terms of probabilistic forecast skill. The framework is demonstrated on the Lorenz63 chaotic dynamical system. Results show that the D2D model captures nontrivial distributional evolution under nonlinear dynamics, produces skillful probabilistic forecasts without explicit ensemble simulation, and remains competitive with, and in some cases outperforms, a simplified perfect model benchmark. These findings point to a new paradigm for probabilistic forecasting, in which predictive distributions are learned and evolved directly rather than reconstructed indirectly through ensemble-based uncertainty propagation.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种直接操作预测分布的分布到分布（D2D）神经概率预测框架，通过核均值嵌入表示输入分布，混合密度网络参数化输出预测分布，实现递归不确定性传播。
AI.motivation: 现有预测方法（无论是基于物理模型还是神经网络）本质上是轨迹导向的，预测分布通常通过集合或采样获得，而不是作为动态对象直接演化。需要一种直接操作预测分布的新范式。
AI.method: 开发了分布到分布（D2D）神经概率预测框架，使用核均值嵌入表示输入分布，混合密度网络参数化输出预测分布，围绕可替换的神经预测模块构建分布编码和解码结构。
AI.result: 在Lorenz63混沌动力系统上验证，D2D模型能捕捉非线性动力学下的非平凡分布演化，无需显式集合模拟即可产生熟练的概率预测，性能与简化完美模型基准相当甚至更优。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种新的概率预测范式，其中预测分布被直接学习和演化，而不是通过基于集合的不确定性传播间接重建。

title: A Learnable SIM Paradigm: Fundamentals, Training Techniques, and Applications
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, accepted by IEEE Wireless Communications Magazine
summary: Stacked intelligent metasurfaces (SIMs) represent a breakthrough in wireless hardware by comprising multilayer, programmable metasurfaces capable of analog computing in the electromagnetic (EM) wave domain. By examining their architectural analogies, this article reveals a deeper connection between SIMs and artificial neural networks (ANNs). Leveraging this profound structural similarity, this work introduces a learnable SIM architecture and proposes a learnable SIM-based machine learning (ML) paradigm for sixth-generation (6G)-andbeyond systems. Then, we develop two SIM-empowered wireless signal processing schemes to effectively achieve multi-user signal separation and distinguish communication signals from jamming signals. The use cases highlight that the proposed SIM-enabled signal processing system can significantly enhance spectrum utilization efficiency and anti-jamming capability in a lightweight manner and pave the way for ultra-efficient and intelligent wireless infrastructures.

AI.tldr: SIMs（堆叠智能超表面）与人工神经网络结构相似，提出可学习的SIM架构用于6G+系统，实现多用户信号分离和抗干扰信号处理。
AI.motivation: SIMs作为多层可编程超表面，能在电磁波域进行模拟计算，但其与人工神经网络的深层结构相似性尚未被充分探索。利用这种相似性可以为6G及未来系统开发更高效、智能的无线信号处理方案。
AI.method: 提出可学习的SIM架构，建立SIM与人工神经网络的类比关系，开发基于SIM的机器学习范式，并设计两种SIM赋能的无线信号处理方案：多用户信号分离和通信信号与干扰信号的区分。
AI.result: SIM赋能的信号处理系统能以轻量级方式显著提升频谱利用效率和抗干扰能力，为超高效智能无线基础设施铺平道路。
AI.conclusion: SIMs与人工神经网络的结构相似性为开发新型无线信号处理提供了重要机会，提出的可学习SIM架构和信号处理方案展示了在6G+系统中实现高效、智能无线通信的潜力。

title: Can an Actor-Critic Optimization Framework Improve Analog Design Optimization?
summary: Analog design often slows down because even small changes to device sizes or biases require expensive simulation cycles, and high-quality solutions typically occupy only a narrow part of a very large search space. While existing optimizers reduce some of this burden, they largely operate without the kind of judgment designers use when deciding where to search next. This paper presents an actor-critic optimization framework (ACOF) for analog sizing that brings that form of guidance into the loop. Rather than treating optimization as a purely black-box search problem, ACOF separates the roles of proposal and evaluation: an actor suggests promising regions of the design space, while a critic reviews those choices, enforces design legality, and redirects the search when progress is hampered. This structure preserves compatibility with standard simulator-based flows while making the search process more deliberate, stable, and interpretable. Across our test circuits, ACOF improves the top-10 figure of merit by an average of 38.9% over the strongest competing baseline and reduces regret by an average of 24.7%, with peak gains of 70.5% in FoM and 42.2% lower regret on individual circuits. By combining iterative reasoning with simulation-driven search, the framework offers a more transparent path toward automated analog sizing across challenging design spaces.

AI.tldr: ACOF是一个用于模拟电路尺寸优化的演员-评论家框架，通过分离提议和评估角色，将设计者判断引入优化循环，相比现有方法显著提升性能指标并降低遗憾值。
AI.motivation: 模拟电路设计面临挑战：微小参数变化需要昂贵的仿真周期，高质量解仅存在于巨大搜索空间的狭窄区域。现有优化器缺乏设计者在决定搜索方向时使用的判断能力。
AI.method: 提出演员-评论家优化框架（ACOF），分离提议和评估角色：演员建议设计空间的有前景区域，评论家评估这些选择、强制执行设计合法性，并在进展受阻时重定向搜索。
AI.result: 在测试电路中，ACOF相比最强基线平均提升前10位性能指标38.9%，平均降低遗憾值24.7%，在单个电路上峰值增益达70.5%的性能指标提升和42.2%的遗憾值降低。
AI.conclusion: 通过将迭代推理与仿真驱动搜索相结合，ACOF为跨挑战性设计空间的自动化模拟尺寸优化提供了更透明、更稳定、更可解释的路径。

title: DyMRL: Dynamic Multispace Representation Learning for Multimodal Event Forecasting in Knowledge Graph
comment: Accepted to The ACM Web Conference 2026 (WWW '26). This version is published under a CC BY license
summary: Accurate representation of multimodal knowledge is crucial for event forecasting in real-world scenarios. However, existing studies have largely focused on static settings, overlooking the dynamic acquisition and fusion of multimodal knowledge. 1) At the knowledge acquisition level, how to learn time-sensitive information of different modalities, especially the dynamic structural modality. Existing dynamic learning methods are often limited to shallow structures across heterogeneous spaces or simple unispaces, making it difficult to capture deep relation-aware geometric features. 2) At the knowledge fusion level, how to learn evolving multimodal fusion features. Existing knowledge fusion methods based on static coattention struggle to capture the varying historical contributions of different modalities to future events. To this end, we propose DyMRL, a Dynamic Multispace Representation Learning approach to efficiently acquire and fuse multimodal temporal knowledge. 1) For the former issue, DyMRL integrates time-specific structural features from Euclidean, hyperbolic, and complex spaces into a relational message-passing framework to learn deep representations, reflecting human intelligences in associative thinking, high-order abstracting, and logical reasoning. Pretrained models endow DyMRL with time-sensitive visual and linguistic intelligences. 2) For the latter concern, DyMRL incorporates advanced dual fusion-evolution attention mechanisms that assign dynamic learning emphases equally to different modalities at different timestamps in a symmetric manner. To evaluate DyMRL's event forecasting performance through leveraging its learned multimodal temporal knowledge in history, we construct four multimodal temporal knowledge graph benchmarks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DyMRL outperforms state-of-the-art dynamic unimodal and static multimodal baseline methods.

AI.tldr: DyMRL提出了一种动态多空间表示学习方法，用于事件预测中的多模态时序知识获取与融合，在四个多模态时序知识图谱基准上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注静态设置，忽视了多模态知识的动态获取与融合。具体问题包括：1）知识获取层面，如何学习不同模态（特别是动态结构模态）的时间敏感信息；2）知识融合层面，如何学习演化的多模态融合特征。
AI.method: DyMRL整合欧几里得、双曲和复数空间的时间特定结构特征到关系消息传递框架中，学习深度表示。同时采用先进的双重融合-演化注意力机制，以对称方式为不同时间戳的不同模态分配动态学习权重。
AI.result: 在构建的四个多模态时序知识图谱基准上，DyMRL在事件预测性能上优于最先进的动态单模态和静态多模态基线方法。
AI.conclusion: DyMRL通过动态多空间表示学习有效解决了多模态时序知识获取与融合的挑战，为事件预测提供了更准确的多模态知识表示。

title: Residual-as-Teacher: Mitigating Bias Propagation in Student--Teacher Estimation
summary: We study statistical estimation in a student--teacher setting, where predictions from a pre-trained teacher are used to guide a student model. A standard approach is to train the student to directly match the teacher's outputs, which we refer to as student soft matching (SM). This approach directly propagates any systematic bias or mis-specification present in the teacher, thereby degrading the student's predictions. We propose and analyze an alternative scheme, known as residual-as-teacher (RaT), in which the teacher is used to estimate residuals in the student's predictions. Our analysis shows how the student can thereby emulate a proximal gradient scheme for solving an oracle optimization problem, and this provably reduces the effect of teacher bias. For general student--teacher pairs, we establish non-asymptotic excess risk bounds for any RaT fixed point, along with convergence guarantees for the student-teacher iterative scheme. For kernel-based student--teacher pairs, we prove a sharp separation: the RaT method achieves the minimax-optimal rate, while the SM method incurs constant prediction error for any sample size. Experiments on both synthetic data and ImageNette classification under covariate shift corroborate our theoretical findings.

AI.tldr: 论文提出并分析了一种名为"残差作为教师"(RaT)的新方法，用于解决传统学生软匹配(SM)方法中教师模型偏差传播的问题。RaT方法通过让教师估计学生预测的残差，使学生能够模拟解决最优优化问题的近端梯度方案，从而减少教师偏差的影响。
AI.motivation: 传统的学生-教师设置中，学生直接匹配教师输出的方法（学生软匹配，SM）会传播教师模型中的系统性偏差或错误设定，从而降低学生的预测性能。需要一种能够减少教师偏差影响的新方法。
AI.method: 提出残差作为教师(RaT)方法：教师用于估计学生预测的残差，而不是直接匹配教师输出。这种方法使学生能够模拟解决最优优化问题的近端梯度方案。分析了RaT固定点的非渐近超额风险界限，以及学生-教师迭代方案的收敛保证。
AI.result: 理论分析表明：对于核基学生-教师对，RaT方法达到极小极大最优率，而SM方法在任何样本量下都会产生恒定预测误差。在合成数据和ImageNette分类的协变量偏移实验中验证了理论发现。
AI.conclusion: RaT方法通过使用教师估计残差而非直接匹配输出，能够有效减少教师偏差的影响，在理论和实验上都优于传统的SM方法，特别是在存在教师模型偏差或错误设定的情况下。

title: FED-HARGPT: A Hybrid Centralized-Federated Approach of a Transformer-based Architecture for Human Context Recognition
comment: Paper presented on: July 2025 Conference: XVII Simpósio Brasileiro de Automação Inteligente (SBAI) At: São João del-Rei
summary: The study explores a hybrid centralized-federated approach for Human Activity Recognition (HAR) using a Transformer-based architecture. With the increasing ubiquity of edge devices, such as smartphones and wearables, a significant amount of private data from wearable and inertial sensors is generated, facilitating discreet monitoring of human activities, including resting, sleeping, and walking. This research focuses on deploying HAR technologies using mobile sensor data and leveraging Federated Learning within the Flower framework to evaluate the training of a federated model derived from a centralized baseline. The experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed hybrid approach in improving the accuracy and robustness of HAR models while preserving data privacy in a non-IID data scenario. The federated learning setup demonstrated comparable performance to centralized models, highlighting the potential of federated learning to strike a balance between data privacy and model performance in real-world applications.

AI.tldr: 提出基于Transformer架构的混合中心化-联邦学习方法用于人类活动识别，在保护数据隐私的同时提升模型性能
AI.motivation: 随着边缘设备普及，大量来自可穿戴设备的私人传感器数据可用于人类活动识别，但需要平衡数据隐私与模型性能
AI.method: 采用Transformer架构，结合中心化与联邦学习混合方法，在Flower框架中实现，处理非独立同分布数据场景
AI.result: 混合方法在非独立同分布数据场景下有效提升人类活动识别模型的准确性和鲁棒性，联邦学习性能与中心化模型相当
AI.conclusion: 联邦学习能在保护数据隐私的同时实现与中心化模型相当的性能，为实际应用中平衡隐私与性能提供了可行方案

title: How unconstrained machine-learning models learn physical symmetries
summary: The requirement of generating predictions that exactly fulfill the fundamental symmetry of the corresponding physical quantities has profoundly shaped the development of machine-learning models for physical simulations. In many cases, models are built using constrained mathematical forms that ensure that symmetries are enforced exactly. However, unconstrained models that do not obey rotational symmetries are often found to have competitive performance, and to be able to \emph{learn} to a high level of accuracy an approximate equivariant behavior with a simple data augmentation strategy. In this paper, we introduce rigorous metrics to measure the symmetry content of the learned representations in such models, and assess the accuracy by which the outputs fulfill the equivariant condition. We apply these metrics to two unconstrained, transformer-based models operating on decorated point clouds (a graph neural network for atomistic simulations and a PointNet-style architecture for particle physics) to investigate how symmetry information is processed across architectural layers and is learned during training. Based on these insights, we establish a rigorous framework for diagnosing spectral failure modes in ML models. Enabled by this analysis, we demonstrate that one can achieve superior stability and accuracy by strategically injecting the minimum required inductive biases, preserving the high expressivity and scalability of unconstrained architectures while guaranteeing physical fidelity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种衡量机器学习模型对称性内容的方法，并展示了如何通过最小化归纳偏置注入来提升无约束模型的物理保真度。
AI.motivation: 尽管无约束模型在物理模拟中表现出色，但它们不保证满足物理量的基本对称性。需要建立严格的指标来评估这些模型学习到的对称性内容，并诊断其失败模式。
AI.method: 引入严格的指标来衡量学习表示中的对称性内容，并评估输出满足等变条件的准确性。将这些指标应用于两个基于transformer的无约束模型（原子模拟的图神经网络和粒子物理的PointNet风格架构），分析对称性信息在架构层中的处理和学习过程。
AI.result: 建立了诊断ML模型频谱失败模式的严格框架。通过战略性注入最小所需归纳偏置，可以在保持无约束架构高表达性和可扩展性的同时，保证物理保真度，实现更优的稳定性和准确性。
AI.conclusion: 通过分析无约束模型中对称性信息的学习过程，可以战略性地注入最小归纳偏置，在保持模型表达性的同时确保物理保真度，为物理模拟的机器学习模型设计提供了新思路。

title: Adaptive Subspace Modeling With Functional Tucker Decomposition
summary: Tensors provide a structured representation for multidimensional data, yet discretization can obscure important information when such data originates from continuous processes. We address this limitation by introducing a functional Tucker decomposition (FTD) that embeds mode-wise continuity constraints directly into the decomposition. The FTD employs reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces (RKHS) to model continuous modes without requiring an a-priori basis, while preserving the multi-linear subspace structure of the Tucker model. Through RKHS-driven representation, the model yields adaptive and expressive factor descriptions that enable targeted modeling of subspaces. The value of this approach is demonstrated in domain-variant tensor classification. In particular, we illustrate its effectiveness with classification tasks in hyperspectral imaging and multivariate time series analysis, highlighting the benefits of combining structural decomposition with functional adaptability.

AI.tldr: 提出功能性Tucker分解(FTD)，在Tucker分解中嵌入模态连续性约束，使用RKHS建模连续模态，无需先验基函数，保持多线性子空间结构，应用于领域变化张量分类。
AI.motivation: 张量为多维数据提供结构化表示，但离散化会掩盖连续过程数据的重要信息。现有方法在处理源自连续过程的张量数据时存在局限性。
AI.method: 引入功能性Tucker分解(FTD)，使用再生核希尔伯特空间(RKHS)建模连续模态，无需先验基函数，同时保持Tucker模型的多线性子空间结构。通过RKHS驱动表示获得自适应和表达性因子描述。
AI.result: 该方法在领域变化张量分类中表现出价值，在高光谱成像和多变量时间序列分析的分类任务中证明了其有效性，展示了结构分解与功能适应性结合的优势。
AI.conclusion: FTD通过嵌入模态连续性约束，结合RKHS建模连续模态，为连续过程产生的张量数据提供了更好的表示方法，在张量分类任务中显示出优越性能。

title: MuViS: Multimodal Virtual Sensing Benchmark
comment: Submitted to European Signal Processing Conference (EUSIPCO) 2026
summary: Virtual sensing aims to infer hard-to-measure quantities from accessible measurements and is central to perception and control in physical systems. Despite rapid progress from first-principle and hybrid models to modern data-driven methods research remains siloed, leaving no established default approach that transfers across processes, modalities, and sensing configurations. We introduce MuViS, a domain-agnostic benchmarking suite for multimodal virtual sensing that consolidates diverse datasets into a unified interface for standardized preprocessing and evaluation. Using this framework, we benchmark established approaches spanning gradient-boosted decision trees and deep neural network (NN) architectures, and show that none of these provides a universal advantage, underscoring the need for generalizable virtual sensing architectures. MuViS is released as an open-source, extensible platform for reproducible comparison and future integration of new datasets and model classes.

AI.tldr: MuViS是一个用于多模态虚拟传感的领域无关基准测试套件，统一了不同数据集和评估标准，发现现有方法在不同场景下没有普遍优势，需要更通用的虚拟传感架构。
AI.motivation: 虚拟传感旨在从可访问的测量中推断难以测量的物理量，是物理系统感知和控制的核心。尽管从第一性原理模型到现代数据驱动方法都有快速进展，但研究仍然孤立，缺乏能够跨过程、模态和传感配置转移的默认方法。
AI.method: 引入MuViS，一个领域无关的多模态虚拟传感基准测试套件，将不同数据集整合到统一的接口中，实现标准化预处理和评估。使用该框架对梯度提升决策树和深度神经网络等现有方法进行基准测试。
AI.result: 基准测试显示，现有方法中没有一种提供普遍优势，强调了需要可泛化的虚拟传感架构。不同方法在不同场景下表现各异，没有单一方法在所有情况下都最优。
AI.conclusion: MuViS作为一个开源、可扩展的平台发布，用于可重复的比较和未来新数据集和模型类的集成。该工作强调了虚拟传感领域需要更通用的架构，并提供了一个标准化评估框架来推动这一方向。

title: Experiential Reflective Learning for Self-Improving LLM Agents
comment: Published as a conference paper at the ICLR 2026 MemAgents Workshop
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled the development of autonomous agents capable of complex reasoning and multi-step problem solving. However, these agents struggle to adapt to specialized environments and do not leverage past interactions, approaching each new task from scratch regardless of their accumulated experience. We introduce Experiential Reflective Learning (ERL), a simple self-improvement framework that enables rapid environment adaptation through experiential learning. ERL reflects on task trajectories and outcomes to generate heuristics, capturing actionable lessons that transfer across tasks. At test time, relevant heuristics are retrieved based on the current task and injected into the agent's context to guide execution. On the Gaia2 benchmark, ERL improves success rate by 7.8% over a ReAct baseline, with large gains in task completion reliability, and outperforms prior experiential learning methods. Through systematic ablations, we find that selective retrieval is essential and that heuristics provide more transferable abstractions than few-shot trajectory prompting. These results demonstrate that reflecting on single-attempt experiences to extract transferable heuristics enables effective agent self-improvement.

AI.tldr: ERL框架通过经验反思学习，从任务轨迹中提取可迁移的启发式规则，提升LLM智能体在专业环境中的适应能力和任务完成率。
AI.motivation: 当前大型语言模型智能体在专业环境中适应能力有限，无法有效利用过往经验，每次任务都从零开始，导致效率低下。
AI.method: 提出经验反思学习框架：1) 从任务轨迹和结果中反思生成启发式规则；2) 测试时根据当前任务检索相关启发式规则；3) 将规则注入智能体上下文指导执行。
AI.result: 在Gaia2基准测试中，ERL比ReAct基线提升7.8%的成功率，任务完成可靠性显著提高，优于现有经验学习方法。选择性检索是关键因素。
AI.conclusion: 通过单次尝试经验反思提取可迁移启发式规则，能有效实现智能体自我改进，为LLM智能体在专业环境中的适应性提供新思路。

title: The Rules-and-Facts Model for Simultaneous Generalization and Memorization in Neural Networks
summary: A key capability of modern neural networks is their capacity to simultaneously learn underlying rules and memorize specific facts or exceptions. Yet, theoretical understanding of this dual capability remains limited. We introduce the Rules-and-Facts (RAF) model, a minimal solvable setting that enables precise characterization of this phenomenon by bridging two classical lines of work in the statistical physics of learning: the teacher-student framework for generalization and Gardner-style capacity analysis for memorization. In the RAF model, a fraction $1 - \varepsilon$ of training labels is generated by a structured teacher rule, while a fraction $\varepsilon$ consists of unstructured facts with random labels. We characterize when the learner can simultaneously recover the underlying rule - allowing generalization to new data - and memorize the unstructured examples. Our results quantify how overparameterization enables the simultaneous realization of these two objectives: sufficient excess capacity supports memorization, while regularization and the choice of kernel or nonlinearity control the allocation of capacity between rule learning and memorization. The RAF model provides a theoretical foundation for understanding how modern neural networks can infer structure while storing rare or non-compressible information.

AI.tldr: 提出RAF模型，从统计物理角度理论分析神经网络如何同时学习规则和记忆事实，量化过参数化如何支持这种双重能力
AI.motivation: 现代神经网络能同时学习底层规则和记忆特定事实，但对此双重能力的理论理解有限，需要建立理论框架来精确描述这一现象
AI.method: 引入Rules-and-Facts (RAF)模型，结合教师-学生框架（规则学习）和Gardner容量分析（记忆），其中训练标签部分来自结构化教师规则，部分来自随机标签的无结构事实
AI.result: 量化了过参数化如何支持同时实现规则恢复和事实记忆：足够的超额容量支持记忆，而正则化和核/非线性选择控制容量在规则学习和记忆间的分配
AI.conclusion: RAF模型为理解现代神经网络如何同时推断结构和存储稀有/不可压缩信息提供了理论基础

title: Analog Computing with Hybrid Couplers and Phase Shifters
summary: Analog computing with microwave signals can enable exceptionally fast computations, potentially surpassing the limits of conventional digital computing. For example, by letting some input signals propagate through a linear microwave network and reading the corresponding output signals, we can instantly compute a matrix-vector product without any digital operations. In this paper, we investigate the computational capabilities of linear microwave networks made exclusively of two low-cost and fundamental components: hybrid couplers and phase shifters, which are both implementable in microstrip. We derive a sufficient and necessary condition characterizing the class of linear transformations that can be computed in the analog domain using these two components. Within this class, we identify three transformations of particular relevance to signal processing, namely the discrete Fourier transform (DFT), the Hadamard transform, and the Haar transform. For each of these, we provide a systematic design method to construct networks of hybrid couplers and phase shifters capable of computing the transformation for any size power of two. To validate our theoretical results, a hardware prototype was designed and fabricated, integrating hybrid couplers and phase shifters to implement the $4\times4$ DFT. A systematic calibration procedure was subsequently developed to characterize the prototype and compensate for fabrication errors. Measured results from the prototype demonstrate successful DFT computation in the analog domain, showing high correlation with theoretical expectations. By realizing an analog computer through standard microwave components, this work demonstrates a practical pathway toward low-latency, real-time analog signal processing.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究使用混合耦合器和移相器构建线性微波网络进行模拟计算，实现了矩阵向量乘法，特别展示了离散傅里叶变换、哈达玛变换和哈尔变换的实现。
AI.motivation: 微波模拟计算能够实现超高速计算，突破传统数字计算的限制。通过线性微波网络实现矩阵向量乘法，无需数字操作即可瞬时完成计算。
AI.method: 使用混合耦合器和移相器两种低成本基础组件构建线性微波网络，推导出这类网络可计算的线性变换的充要条件，为三种重要变换（DFT、Hadamard、Haar）提供系统化设计方法，并制作了4×4 DFT硬件原型。
AI.result: 建立了混合耦合器和移相器网络可计算线性变换的完整理论框架，成功设计并制作了4×4 DFT硬件原型，测量结果与理论预期高度吻合，验证了模拟计算的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 通过标准微波组件实现模拟计算机，为低延迟、实时模拟信号处理提供了实用途径，展示了微波模拟计算在高速信号处理中的潜力。

title: Learning Mesh-Free Discrete Differential Operators with Self-Supervised Graph Neural Networks
summary: Mesh-free numerical methods provide flexible discretisations for complex geometries; however, classical meshless discrete differential operators typically trade low computational cost for limited accuracy or high accuracy for substantial per-stencil computation. We introduce a parametrised framework for learning mesh-free discrete differential operators using a graph neural network trained via polynomial moment constraints derived from truncated Taylor expansions. The model maps local stencils relative positions directly to discrete operator weights. The current work demonstrates that neural networks can learn classical polynomial consistency while retaining robustness to irregular neighbourhood geometry. The learned operators depend only on local geometry, are resolution-agnostic, and can be reused across particle configurations and governing equations. We evaluate the framework using standard numerical analysis diagnostics, showing improved accuracy over Smoothed Particle Hydrodynamics, and a favourable accuracy-cost trade-off relative to a representative high-order consistent mesh-free method in the moderate-accuracy regime. Applicability is demonstrated by solving the weakly compressible Navier-Stokes equations using the learned operators.

AI.tldr: 提出基于图神经网络的参数化框架，用于学习无网格离散微分算子，通过多项式矩约束训练，实现几何鲁棒、分辨率无关的算子学习
AI.motivation: 传统无网格方法在计算成本与精度之间存在权衡：要么低计算成本但精度有限，要么高精度但计算开销大。需要一种既能保持高精度又具有计算效率的方法
AI.method: 使用图神经网络框架，通过多项式矩约束（来自截断泰勒展开）进行训练，将局部模板相对位置直接映射到离散算子权重。学习到的算子仅依赖于局部几何，具有分辨率无关性
AI.result: 神经网络能够学习经典多项式一致性，同时保持对不规则邻域几何的鲁棒性。在标准数值分析诊断中，相比平滑粒子流体动力学方法精度更高，在中等精度范围内相比代表性高阶一致无网格方法具有更好的精度-成本权衡
AI.conclusion: 该框架成功学习了具有几何鲁棒性的无网格离散微分算子，能够求解弱可压缩Navier-Stokes方程，展示了在实际问题中的适用性

title: On Performance of Fluid Antenna Relay (FAR)-Assisted AAV-NOMA Wireless Network
summary: In this paper, we investigate the performance of a fluid antenna relay (FAR)-assisted downlink communication system utilizing non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA). The FAR, which integrates a fluid antenna system (FAS), is equipped on an autonomous aerial vehicle (AAV), and introduces extra degrees of freedom to improve the performance of the system. The transmission is divided into a first phase from the base station (BS) to the users and the FAR, and a second phase where the FAR forwards the signal using amplify-and-forward (AF) or decode-and-forward (DF) relaying to reduce the outage probability (OP) for the user maintaining weaker channel conditions. To analyze the OP performance of the weak user, Copula theory and the Gaussian copula function are employed to model the statistical distribution of the FAS channels. Analytical expressions for weak user's OP are derived for both the AF and the DF schemes. Simulation results validate the effectiveness of the proposed scheme, showing that it consistently outperforms benchmark schemes without the FAR. In addition, numerical simulations also demonstrate the values of the relaying scheme selection parameter under different FAR positions and communication outage thresholds.

AI.tldr: 本文研究基于流体天线中继的NOMA下行通信系统性能，通过无人机搭载流体天线系统，采用AF或DF中继降低弱用户中断概率，利用Copula理论建模信道分布。
AI.motivation: 传统通信系统中，弱用户由于信道条件差容易发生中断。本文旨在通过无人机搭载的流体天线中继系统，利用NOMA技术提高系统性能，特别是改善弱用户的中断概率。
AI.method: 1) 构建基于流体天线中继的NOMA下行通信系统；2) 采用两阶段传输：基站到用户和FAR，FAR转发信号；3) 使用AF和DF两种中继方案；4) 应用Copula理论和Gaussian copula函数建模FAS信道统计分布；5) 推导弱用户中断概率的解析表达式。
AI.result: 1) 推导出AF和DF方案下弱用户中断概率的解析表达式；2) 仿真验证了所提方案优于无FAR的基准方案；3) 数值模拟展示了不同FAR位置和通信中断阈值下的中继方案选择参数值。
AI.conclusion: 基于流体天线中继的NOMA系统能有效降低弱用户中断概率，Copula理论为FAS信道建模提供了有效方法，系统性能优于传统方案，且中继方案选择参数对系统优化有重要指导意义。

title: Physics-Informed Neural Network Digital Twin for Dynamic Tray-Wise Modeling of Distillation Columns under Transient Operating Conditions
summary: Digital twin technology, when combined with physics-informed machine learning with simulation results of Aspen, offers transformative capabilities for industrial process monitoring, control, and optimization. In this work, the proposed model presents a Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) digital twin framework for the dynamic, tray-wise modeling of binary distillation columns operating under transient conditions. The architecture of the proposed model embeds fundamental thermodynamic constraints, including vapor-liquid equilibrium (VLE) described by modified Raoult's law, tray-level mass and energy balances, and the McCabe-Thiele graphical methodology directly into the neural network loss function via physics residual terms. The model is trained and evaluated on a high-fidelity synthetic dataset of 961 timestamped measurements spanning 8 hours of transient operation, generated in Aspen HYSYS for a binary HX/TX distillation system comprising 16 sensor streams. An adaptive loss-weighting scheme balances the data fidelity and physics consistency objectives during training. Compared to five data-driven baselines (LSTM, vanilla MLP, GRU, Transformer, DeepONet), the proposed PINN achieves an RMSE of 0.00143 for HX mole fraction prediction (R^2 = 0.9887), representing a 44.6% reduction over the best data-only baseline, while strictly satisfying thermodynamic constraints. Tray-wise temperature and composition profiles predicted under transient perturbations demonstrate that the digital twin accurately captures column dynamics including feed tray responses, reflux ratio variations, and pressure transients. These results establish the proposed PINN digital twin as a robust foundation for real-time soft sensing, model-predictive control, and anomaly detection in industrial distillation processes.

AI.tldr: 提出基于物理信息神经网络(PINN)的数字孪生框架，用于二元精馏塔的动态建模，通过嵌入热力学约束实现比纯数据驱动方法更准确的预测
AI.motivation: 工业精馏过程需要准确、符合物理规律的动态模型用于监控、控制和优化。传统数据驱动方法缺乏物理一致性，而纯物理模型计算复杂。需要结合物理约束与数据驱动方法的优势。
AI.method: 提出PINN数字孪生框架，在神经网络损失函数中嵌入热力学约束：气液平衡(修正拉乌尔定律)、塔板级质量能量平衡、McCabe-Thiele方法。采用自适应损失权重平衡数据保真度与物理一致性。使用Aspen HYSYS生成的961个时间戳测量数据进行训练。
AI.result: HX摩尔分数预测RMSE为0.00143(R²=0.9887)，比最佳纯数据驱动基线(LSTM等)降低44.6%。模型严格满足热力学约束，能准确捕捉塔板温度、组成分布动态响应，包括进料板响应、回流比变化和压力瞬变。
AI.conclusion: PINN数字孪生框架为工业精馏过程提供了鲁棒的实时软测量、模型预测控制和异常检测基础，成功结合了物理约束与数据驱动优势。

title: Can LLMs Beat Classical Hyperparameter Optimization Algorithms? A Study on autoresearch
summary: The autoresearch repository enables an LLM agent to search for optimal hyperparameter configurations on an unconstrained search space by editing the training code directly. Given a fixed compute budget and constraints, we use \emph{autoresearch} as a testbed to compare classical hyperparameter optimization (HPO) algorithms against LLM-based methods on tuning the hyperparameters of a small language model. Within a fixed hyperparameter search space, classical HPO methods such as CMA-ES and TPE consistently outperform LLM-based agents. However, an LLM agent that directly edits training source code in an unconstrained search space narrows the gap to classical methods substantially despite using only a self-hosted open-weight 27B model. Methods that avoid out-of-memory failures outperform those with higher search diversity, suggesting that reliability matters more than exploration breadth. While small and mid-sized LLMs struggle to track optimization state across trials, classical methods lack domain knowledge. To bridge this gap, we introduce Centaur, a hybrid that shares CMA-ES's internal state, including mean vector, step-size, and covariance matrix, with an LLM. Centaur achieves the best result in our experiments, with its 0.8B variant outperforming the 27B variant, suggesting that a cheap LLM suffices when paired with a strong classical optimizer. The 0.8B model is insufficient for unconstrained code editing but sufficient for hybrid optimization, while scaling to 27B provides no advantage for fixed search space methods with the open-weight models tested. Code is available at https://github.com/ferreirafabio/autoresearch-automl.

AI.tldr: LLM代理通过直接编辑训练代码在无约束搜索空间中进行超参数优化，与经典HPO方法对比发现，经典方法在固定搜索空间表现更好，但LLM在无约束空间能显著缩小差距。结合LLM与CMA-ES的混合方法Centaur表现最佳，小模型(0.8B)配合经典优化器效果优于大模型(27B)。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是比较经典超参数优化(HPO)算法与基于LLM的方法在小语言模型超参数调优上的性能差异，探索LLM在无约束搜索空间中的潜力，以及如何结合两者的优势。
AI.method: 使用autoresearch作为测试平台，对比CMA-ES、TPE等经典HPO方法与LLM代理方法。LLM代理直接编辑训练源代码实现无约束搜索。提出混合方法Centaur，将CMA-ES的内部状态（均值向量、步长、协方差矩阵）与LLM共享。
AI.result: 在固定搜索空间中，经典HPO方法（CMA-ES、TPE）始终优于LLM代理。但LLM在无约束搜索空间中能显著缩小差距。混合方法Centaur表现最佳，其0.8B变体优于27B变体。避免内存溢出的方法比高搜索多样性的方法表现更好。
AI.conclusion: 可靠性比探索广度更重要；小型LLM难以跨试验跟踪优化状态，而经典方法缺乏领域知识；结合LLM与经典优化器的混合方法效果最佳；小模型(0.8B)配合强经典优化器足够有效，大模型在固定搜索空间方法中未提供优势。

title: Near-field Beam Training under Multi-path Channels: A Hybrid Learning-and-Optimization Approach
comment: Submitted to IEEE for possible publication
summary: For extremely large-scale arrays (XL-arrays), the discrete Fourier transform (DFT) codebook, conventionally used in the far-field, has recently been employed for near-field beam training. However, most existing methods rely on the line-of-sight (LoS) dominant channel assumption, which may suffer degraded communication performance when applied to the general multi-path scenario due to the more complex received signal power pattern at the user. To address this issue, we propose in this paper a new hybrid learning-and-optimization-based beam training method that first leverages deep learning (DL) to obtain coarse channel parameter estimates, and then refines them via a model-based optimization algorithm, hence achieving high-accuracy estimation with low computational complexity. Specifically, in the first stage, a tailored U-Net architecture is developed to learn the non-linear mapping from the received power pattern to coarse estimates of the angles and ranges of multi-path components. In particular, the inherent permutation ambiguity in multi-path parameter matching is effectively resolved by a permutation invariant training (PIT) strategy, while the unknown number of paths is estimated based on defined path existence logits. In the second stage, we further propose an efficient particle swarm optimization method to refine the angular and range parameters within a confined search region; in the meanwhile, a Gerchberg-Saxton algorithm is used to retrieve multi-path channel gains from the received power pattern. Last, numerical results demonstrate that the proposed hybrid design significantly outperforms various benchmarks in terms of parameter estimation accuracy and achievable rate, yet with low computational complexity.

AI.tldr: 提出一种混合学习与优化的波束训练方法，结合深度学习粗估计与模型优化精修，解决XL阵列近场多径场景下的高精度信道参数估计问题。
AI.motivation: 传统基于DFT码本的波束训练方法在远场场景有效，但在XL阵列近场多径场景下，由于接收信号功率模式更复杂，现有方法依赖视距主导信道假设，在多径场景下性能下降。
AI.method: 提出两阶段混合方法：1) 使用定制U-Net架构从接收功率模式学习多径角度和距离的粗估计，采用排列不变训练解决参数匹配歧义，基于路径存在逻辑估计未知路径数；2) 使用粒子群优化在受限搜索区域精修角度和距离参数，同时用Gerchberg-Saxton算法从接收功率模式恢复多径信道增益。
AI.result: 数值结果表明，所提混合设计在参数估计精度和可达速率方面显著优于各种基准方法，同时保持低计算复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 提出的混合学习与优化方法有效解决了XL阵列近场多径场景下的波束训练问题，实现了高精度信道参数估计和低计算复杂度的平衡。

title: Once-for-All Channel Mixers (HYPERTINYPW): Generative Compression for TinyML
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at MLSys 2026. TinyML / on-device learning paper on hypernetwork-based compression for ECG and other 1D biosignals, with integer-only inference on commodity MCUs. Evaluated on Apnea-ECG, PTB-XL, and MIT-BIH. Camera-ready version with additional datasets, experiments, and insights will appear after May 2026
summary: Deploying neural networks on microcontrollers is constrained by kilobytes of flash and SRAM, where 1x1 pointwise (PW) mixers often dominate memory even after INT8 quantization across vision, audio, and wearable sensing. We present HYPER-TINYPW, a compression-as-generation approach that replaces most stored PW weights with generated weights: a shared micro-MLP synthesizes PW kernels once at load time from tiny per-layer codes, caches them, and executes them with standard integer operators. This preserves commodity MCU runtimes and adds only a one-off synthesis cost; steady-state latency and energy match INT8 separable CNN baselines. Enforcing a shared latent basis across layers removes cross-layer redundancy, while keeping PW1 in INT8 stabilizes early, morphology-sensitive mixing. We contribute (i) TinyML-faithful packed-byte accounting covering generator, heads/factorization, codes, kept PW1, and backbone; (ii) a unified evaluation with validation-tuned t* and bootstrap confidence intervals; and (iii) a deployability analysis covering integer-only inference and boot versus lazy synthesis. On three ECG benchmarks (Apnea-ECG, PTB-XL, MIT-BIH), HYPER-TINYPW shifts the macro-F1 versus flash Pareto frontier: at about 225 kB it matches a roughly 1.4 MB CNN while being 6.31x smaller (84.15% fewer bytes), retaining at least 95% of large-model macro-F1. Under 32-64 kB budgets it sustains balanced detection where compact baselines degrade. The mechanism applies broadly to other 1D biosignals, on-device speech, and embedded sensing tasks where per-layer redundancy dominates, indicating a wider role for compression-as-generation in resource-constrained ML systems. Beyond ECG, HYPER-TINYPW transfers to TinyML audio: on Speech Commands it reaches 96.2% test accuracy (98.2% best validation), supporting broader applicability to embedded sensing workloads where repeated linear mixers dominate memory.

AI.tldr: HYPER-TINYPW：一种压缩即生成方法，用生成的权重替换存储的点积混合器权重，通过微MLP从微小层代码合成内核，大幅减少内存占用，在微控制器上保持运行时性能。
AI.motivation: 在微控制器上部署神经网络受限于KB级闪存和SRAM，1x1点积混合器在INT8量化后仍占主导内存。需要解决内存瓶颈，同时保持推理性能。
AI.method: 采用压缩即生成方法：共享的微MLP在加载时从微小层代码合成点积内核并缓存，使用标准整数运算符执行。保留INT8可分离CNN基线，保持PW1在INT8以稳定早期混合。
AI.result: 在三个ECG基准测试中，HYPER-TINYPW在约225kB时匹配约1.4MB CNN，缩小6.31倍（减少84.15%字节），保持至少95%大模型宏F1。在32-64kB预算下保持平衡检测。在语音命令上达到96.2%测试准确率。
AI.conclusion: HYPER-TINYPW通过压缩即生成方法显著减少内存占用，同时保持性能，适用于ECG、语音命令等嵌入式传感任务，为资源受限ML系统提供了有效解决方案。

title: Efficient compressive sensing for machinery vibration signals
summary: Mechanical vibration monitoring often requires high sampling rates and generates large data volumes, posing challenges for storage, transmission, and power efficiency. Compressive Sensing (CS) offers a promising approach to overcome these constraints by exploiting signal sparsity to enable sub-Nyquist acquisition and efficient reconstruction. This study presents a comprehensive comparative analysis of the key components of the CS framework: sparse basis, measurement matrix, and reconstruction algorithm for machinery vibration signals. In addition, a hardware-efficient measurement matrix, the Wang matrix, originally developed for image compression, is introduced and evaluated for the first time in this context. Experimental assessment using the HUMS2023 and the CETIM gearbox datasets demonstrates that this matrix achieves superior reconstruction quality, with higher SNR, compared to conventional Gaussian and Bernoulli matrices, especially at high compression ratios.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了压缩感知框架的关键组件（稀疏基、测量矩阵、重建算法）在机械振动信号中的应用，并首次评估了硬件高效的Wang矩阵，证明其在高压縮比下优于传统矩阵。
AI.motivation: 机械振动监测需要高采样率，产生大量数据，给存储、传输和能效带来挑战。压缩感知通过利用信号稀疏性实现亚奈奎斯特采集和高效重建，为解决这些约束提供了有前景的方法。
AI.method: 对压缩感知框架的关键组件进行综合比较分析：稀疏基、测量矩阵和重建算法。首次引入并评估了为图像压缩开发的硬件高效测量矩阵——Wang矩阵，在机械振动信号中的应用。使用HUMS2023和CETIM齿轮箱数据集进行实验评估。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，Wang矩阵在重建质量上优于传统的高斯和伯努利矩阵，特别是在高压缩比下，能够获得更高的信噪比(SNR)。
AI.conclusion: Wang矩阵作为硬件高效的测量矩阵，在机械振动信号的压缩感知应用中表现出色，特别是在高压縮比情况下，为实际工程应用提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Energy-Efficient Hierarchical Federated Anomaly Detection for the Internet of Underwater Things via Selective Cooperative Aggregation
summary: Anomaly detection is a core service in the Internet of Underwater Things, yet training accurate distributed models underwater is difficult because acoustic links are low-bandwidth, energy-intensive, and often unable to support direct sensor-to-surface communication. Standard flat federated learning therefore faces two coupled limitations in underwater deployments: expensive long-range transmissions and reduced participation when only a subset of sensors can reach the gateway. This paper proposes an energy-efficient hierarchical federated learning framework for underwater anomaly detection based on three components: feasibility-aware sensor-to-fog association, compressed model-update transmission, and selective cooperative aggregation among fog nodes. The proposed three-tier architecture localises most communication within short-range clusters while activating fog-to-fog exchange only when smaller clusters can benefit from nearby larger neighbours. A physics-grounded underwater acoustic model is used to evaluate detection quality, communication energy, and network participation jointly. In large synthetic deployments, only about 48% of sensors can directly reach the gateway in the 200-sensor case, whereas hierarchical learning preserves full participation through feasible fog paths. Selective cooperation matches the detection accuracy of always-on inter-fog exchange while reducing its energy by 31-33%, and compressed uploads reduce total energy by 71-95% in matched sensitivity tests. Experiments on three real benchmarks further show that low-overhead hierarchical methods remain competitive in detection quality, while flat federated learning defines the minimum-energy operating point. These results provide practical design guidance for underwater deployments operating under severe acoustic communication constraints.

AI.tldr: 提出用于水下异常检测的节能分层联邦学习框架，通过传感器-雾节点关联、压缩模型更新和选择性雾节点协作，解决水下通信带宽低、能耗高的问题。
AI.motivation: 水下物联网中异常检测是核心服务，但水下声学通信带宽低、能耗高，且传感器无法直接与水面通信。传统平面联邦学习在水下部署面临两个耦合限制：昂贵的长距离传输和只有部分传感器能到达网关导致的参与度降低。
AI.method: 提出三层次架构：1) 可行性感知的传感器-雾节点关联；2) 压缩模型更新传输；3) 雾节点间的选择性协作聚合。该架构将大部分通信限制在短距离集群内，仅当较小集群能从邻近较大邻居受益时才激活雾节点间交换。
AI.result: 在200个传感器的大规模合成部署中，只有约48%的传感器能直接到达网关，而分层学习通过可行的雾路径保持完全参与。选择性协作匹配始终开启的雾间交换的检测精度，同时减少31-33%的能耗。压缩上传在匹配灵敏度测试中减少总能耗71-95%。三个真实基准测试表明，低开销分层方法在检测质量上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 分层联邦学习框架为在严重声学通信约束下运行的水下部署提供了实用设计指导，平衡了检测质量、通信能耗和网络参与度，而平面联邦学习定义了最小能耗操作点。

title: The Order Is The Message
summary: In a controlled experiment on modular arithmetic ($p = 9973$), varying only example ordering while holding all else constant, two fixed-ordering strategies achieve 99.5\% test accuracy by epochs 487 and 659 respectively from a training set comprising 0.3\% of the input space, well below established sample complexity lower bounds for this task under IID ordering. The IID baseline achieves 0.30\% after 5{,}000 epochs from identical data. An adversarially structured ordering suppresses learning entirely. The generalizing model reliably constructs a Fourier representation whose fundamental frequency is the Fourier dual of the ordering structure, encoding information present in no individual training example, with the same fundamental emerging across all seeds tested regardless of initialization or training set composition. We discuss implications for training efficiency, the reinterpretation of grokking, and the safety risks of a channel that evades all content-level auditing.

AI.tldr: 研究发现训练样本顺序对模型学习有巨大影响：固定顺序策略能在远低于IID样本复杂度下实现高精度，而对抗性顺序则完全抑制学习。模型构建的傅里叶表示与顺序结构相关，这一现象对训练效率、grokking现象和安全风险有重要启示。
AI.motivation: 探索训练数据顺序对模型学习能力的影响，特别是在样本复杂度远低于理论下界的情况下，研究顺序结构如何影响模型泛化能力和学习效率。
AI.method: 在模算术任务（p=9973）上进行控制实验，仅改变训练样本顺序而保持其他所有条件不变。比较固定顺序策略、IID顺序和对抗性顺序三种情况，分析模型在不同顺序下的学习表现和傅里叶表示。
AI.result: 固定顺序策略在训练集仅占输入空间0.3%的情况下，分别在第487和659个epoch达到99.5%测试精度，远低于IID顺序的理论样本复杂度下界。IID基线在5000个epoch后仅达到0.30%精度。对抗性顺序完全抑制学习。模型构建的傅里叶表示的基本频率与顺序结构相关，这一现象在不同种子和训练集组成中一致出现。
AI.conclusion: 训练样本顺序是影响模型学习的关键因素，能够显著降低样本复杂度要求。模型能够从顺序结构中提取信息构建泛化表示，这一发现对理解grokking现象、提高训练效率有重要意义，同时也揭示了绕过内容审计的安全风险。

title: Rate-Splitting Multiple Access with a SIC-Free Receiver: An Experimental Study
summary: Most Rate-Splitting Multiple Access (RSMA) implementations rely on successive interference cancellation (SIC) at the receiver, whose performance is inherently limited by error propagation during common-stream decoding. This paper addresses this issue by developing a SIC-free RSMA receiver based on joint demapping (JD), which directly evaluates bit vectors over a composite constellation. Using a two-user Multiple-Input Single-Output (MISO) prototype, we conduct over-the-air measurements to systematically compare SIC and JD-based receivers. The results show that the proposed SIC-free receiver provides stronger reliability and better practicality over a wider operating range, with all observations being consistent with theoretical expectations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于联合解映射的无SIC RSMA接收机，通过直接评估复合星座上的比特向量来避免SIC中的错误传播问题，在MISO原型系统中展示了比传统SIC接收机更强的可靠性和更广的工作范围。
AI.motivation: 传统RSMA实现依赖接收端的连续干扰消除(SIC)，其性能受到公共流解码过程中错误传播的固有限制。为了解决这个问题，需要开发一种无SIC的接收机方案。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于联合解映射(JD)的无SIC RSMA接收机，该方法直接在复合星座上评估比特向量。使用两用户多输入单输出(MISO)原型系统进行空中测量，系统比较SIC和JD两种接收机。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，提出的无SIC接收机在更宽的工作范围内提供了更强的可靠性和更好的实用性，所有观察结果均与理论预期一致。
AI.conclusion: 基于联合解映射的无SIC RSMA接收机能够有效克服传统SIC接收机中的错误传播问题，在实际系统中展现出优越的性能和实用性。

title: Amplified Patch-Level Differential Privacy for Free via Random Cropping
summary: Random cropping is one of the most common data augmentation techniques in computer vision, yet the role of its inherent randomness in training differentially private machine learning models has thus far gone unexplored. We observe that when sensitive content in an image is spatially localized, such as a face or license plate, random cropping can probabilistically exclude that content from the model's input. This introduces a third source of stochasticity in differentially private training with stochastic gradient descent, in addition to gradient noise and minibatch sampling. This additional randomness amplifies differential privacy without requiring changes to model architecture or training procedure. We formalize this effect by introducing a patch-level neighboring relation for vision data and deriving tight privacy bounds for differentially private stochastic gradient descent (DP-SGD) when combined with random cropping. Our analysis quantifies the patch inclusion probability and shows how it composes with minibatch sampling to yield a lower effective sampling rate. Empirically, we validate that patch-level amplification improves the privacy-utility trade-off across multiple segmentation architectures and datasets. Our results demonstrate that aligning privacy accounting with domain structure and additional existing sources of randomness can yield stronger guarantees at no additional cost.

AI.tldr: 随机裁剪作为数据增强技术，在训练差分隐私模型时能通过概率性排除敏感内容来增强隐私保护，无需改变模型架构或训练过程。
AI.motivation: 随机裁剪是计算机视觉中常见的数据增强技术，但其在差分隐私训练中的随机性作用尚未被充分探索。当图像中的敏感内容（如人脸、车牌）空间局部化时，随机裁剪可以概率性地排除这些内容，从而增强隐私保护。
AI.method: 提出图像数据的补丁级相邻关系，推导随机裁剪与差分隐私随机梯度下降（DP-SGD）结合时的紧致隐私边界。分析补丁包含概率，展示其如何与小批量采样组合以降低有效采样率。
AI.result: 理论分析量化了补丁包含概率，实证验证了补丁级增强在多个分割架构和数据集上改善了隐私-效用权衡。结果表明，将隐私计算与领域结构和现有随机性对齐可以在不增加成本的情况下获得更强的隐私保证。
AI.conclusion: 随机裁剪的随机性为差分隐私训练提供了第三种随机性来源（除梯度噪声和小批量采样外），通过概率性排除敏感内容来增强隐私保护。将隐私计算与数据领域结构对齐可以以零成本获得更强的隐私保证。

title: Vision Hopfield Memory Networks
summary: Recent vision and multimodal foundation backbones, such as Transformer families and state-space models like Mamba, have achieved remarkable progress, enabling unified modeling across images, text, and beyond. Despite their empirical success, these architectures remain far from the computational principles of the human brain, often demanding enormous amounts of training data while offering limited interpretability. In this work, we propose the Vision Hopfield Memory Network (V-HMN), a brain-inspired foundation backbone that integrates hierarchical memory mechanisms with iterative refinement updates. Specifically, V-HMN incorporates local Hopfield modules that provide associative memory dynamics at the image patch level, global Hopfield modules that function as episodic memory for contextual modulation, and a predictive-coding-inspired refinement rule for iterative error correction. By organizing these memory-based modules hierarchically, V-HMN captures both local and global dynamics in a unified framework. Memory retrieval exposes the relationship between inputs and stored patterns, making decisions more interpretable, while the reuse of stored patterns improves data efficiency. This brain-inspired design therefore enhances interpretability and data efficiency beyond existing self-attention- or state-space-based approaches. We conducted extensive experiments on public computer vision benchmarks, and V-HMN achieved competitive results against widely adopted backbone architectures, while offering better interpretability, higher data efficiency, and stronger biological plausibility. These findings highlight the potential of V-HMN to serve as a next-generation vision foundation model, while also providing a generalizable blueprint for multimodal backbones in domains such as text and audio, thereby bridging brain-inspired computation with large-scale machine learning.

AI.tldr: V-HMN是一种受大脑启发的视觉基础骨干网络，通过整合层次化记忆机制和迭代精炼更新，在保持竞争力的同时提供更好的可解释性、数据效率和生物合理性。
AI.motivation: 现有Transformer和Mamba等视觉/多模态基础模型虽然取得了显著进展，但距离人脑计算原理较远，需要大量训练数据且可解释性有限。研究者希望开发更接近大脑计算原理的架构。
AI.method: 提出Vision Hopfield Memory Network (V-HMN)，包含：1) 局部Hopfield模块（图像块级别的联想记忆动态）；2) 全局Hopfield模块（上下文调制的情景记忆）；3) 预测编码启发的精炼规则（迭代误差校正）。这些记忆模块按层次组织，形成统一框架。
AI.result: 在公共计算机视觉基准测试中，V-HMN取得了与广泛采用骨干架构相竞争的结果，同时提供更好的可解释性、更高的数据效率和更强的生物合理性。
AI.conclusion: V-HMN有潜力成为下一代视觉基础模型，并为文本、音频等多模态骨干提供通用蓝图，从而桥接大脑启发计算与大规模机器学习。

title: Joint Training Scattering Matrix Learning and Channel Estimation for Beyond-Diagonal Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces
summary: Beyond-diagonal reconfigurable intelligent surface (BD-RIS) generalizes the conventional diagonal RIS (D-RIS) by introducing tunable inter-element connections, offering enhanced wave manipulation capabilities. However, realizing the advantages of BD-RIS requires accurate channel state information (CSI), whose acquisition becomes significantly more challenging due to the increased number of channel coefficients, leading to prohibitively large pilot training overhead in BD-RIS-aided multi-user multiple-input multiple-output (MU-MIMO) systems. Existing studies reduce pilot overhead by exploiting the channel correlations induced by the Kronecker-product or multi-linear structure of BD-RIS-aided channels, which neglect the spatial correlation among antennas and the statistical correlation across RIS-user channels. In this paper, we propose a learning-based channel estimation framework, namely the joint training scattering matrix learning and channel estimation framework (JTSMLCEF), which jointly optimizes the BD-RIS training scattering matrix and estimates the cascaded channels in an end-to-end manner to achieve accurate channel estimation and reduce the pilot overhead. The proposed JTSMLCEF follows a two-phase channel estimation protocol to enable adaptive training scattering matrix optimization with a training scattering matrix optimizer (TSMO) and cascaded channel estimation with a dual-attention channel estimator (DACE). Specifically, the DACE is designed with intra-user and inter-user attention modules to capture the multi-dimensional correlations in multi-user cascaded channels. Simulation results demonstrate the superiority of JTSMLCEF. Compared with the current state-of-the-art method, it reduces the pilot overhead by $80\%$ while further reducing the normalized mean squared error (NMSE) by $82.6\%$ and $92.5\%$ in indoor and urban micro-cell (UMi) scenarios, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出JTSMLCEF框架，通过联合优化BD-RIS训练散射矩阵和级联信道估计，在MU-MIMO系统中显著降低导频开销并提升信道估计精度。
AI.motivation: BD-RIS虽然增强了波束操控能力，但信道系数增加导致CSI获取困难，现有方法忽略了天线空间相关性和RIS-用户信道统计相关性，导频开销过大。
AI.method: 提出JTSMLCEF学习框架，采用两阶段信道估计协议：1) 训练散射矩阵优化器(TSMO)自适应优化训练散射矩阵；2) 双注意力信道估计器(DACE)通过用户内和用户间注意力模块捕获多用户级联信道的多维相关性。
AI.result: 相比现有最优方法，导频开销降低80%，室内和UMi场景下的NMSE分别降低82.6%和92.5%。
AI.conclusion: JTSMLCEF框架能有效解决BD-RIS辅助MU-MIMO系统中的信道估计挑战，显著降低导频开销并提升估计精度。

title: Training LLMs for Multi-Step Tool Orchestration with Constrained Data Synthesis and Graduated Rewards
summary:
Multi-step tool orchestration, where LLMs must invoke multiple dependent APIs in the correct order while propagating intermediate outputs, remains challenging. State-of-the-art models frequently fail on full sequence execution, with parameter value errors accounting for a significant portion of failures. Training models to handle such workflows faces two obstacles: existing environments focus on simple per-turn function calls with simulated data, and binary rewards provide no signal for partial correctness.
  We present a framework addressing both challenges. First, we construct a reinforcement learning environment backed by a large-scale cache of real API responses, enabling a data synthesis pipeline that samples valid multi-step orchestration traces with controllable complexity and significantly higher generation efficiency than unconstrained methods. Second, we propose a graduated reward design that decomposes correctness into atomic validity (individual function call correctness at increasing granularity) and orchestration (correct tool sequencing with dependency respect). On ComplexFuncBench, our approach demonstrates substantial improvements in turn accuracy. Ablation studies confirm both reward components are essential: using either alone significantly degrades performance.

AI.tldr: 提出一个强化学习框架，通过真实API响应缓存构建多步骤工具编排环境，并设计分级奖励机制，显著提升LLM在复杂函数调用序列上的执行准确性。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM在多步骤工具编排（需要按正确顺序调用多个依赖API并传递中间输出）方面存在挑战，现有方法在完整序列执行上经常失败，参数值错误是主要失败原因。训练模型面临两个障碍：现有环境只关注简单的单轮函数调用且使用模拟数据，二元奖励无法为部分正确提供信号。
AI.method: 1. 构建基于大规模真实API响应缓存的强化学习环境，支持数据合成管道，可采样具有可控复杂度的有效多步骤编排轨迹，生成效率显著高于无约束方法。2. 提出分级奖励设计，将正确性分解为原子有效性（单个函数调用在不同粒度上的正确性）和编排（工具序列正确且尊重依赖关系）。
AI.result: 在ComplexFuncBench基准测试中，该方法在轮次准确性上显示出显著改进。消融研究证实两个奖励组件都至关重要：单独使用任一组件的性能都会显著下降。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过真实API环境和高粒度奖励设计，有效解决了多步骤工具编排的挑战，为训练LLM处理复杂工作流提供了更有效的解决方案。

title: Multi-User Covert Communication in Spatially Heterogeneous Wireless Networks
summary: This paper investigates an uplink multi-user covert communication system with spatially distributed users. Unlike prior works that approximate channel statistics using averaged parameters and homogeneous assumptions, this study explicitly models each user's geometric position and corresponding user-to-Willie and user-to-Bob channel variances. This approach enables an accurate characterization of spatially heterogeneous covert environments. We mathematically prove that a generalized on-off power control scheme, which jointly accounts for both Bob's and Willie's channels, constitutes the optimal transmission strategy in heterogeneous user configurations. Leveraging the optimal strategy, we derive closed-form expressions for the minimum detection error probability and the minimum number of cooperative users required to satisfy a covert constraint. With the closed-form expressions, comprehensive theoretical analyses are conducted, which are validated by Monte-Carlo simulations. One important insight obtained from the analysis is that user spatial heterogeneity can enhance covert communication performance. Building on these findings, a piecewise search algorithm is proposed to achieve exact optimality with significantly reduced computational complexity. We demonstrate that optimization considering user's spatial heterogeneity achieves substantially improved covert communication performance than that based on the assumption of spatial homogeneity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了具有空间分布用户的上行多用户隐蔽通信系统，通过精确建模用户几何位置和信道方差，证明了广义开关功率控制方案是最优策略，并推导了最小检测错误概率和所需协作用户数的闭式表达式。
AI.motivation: 先前研究通常使用平均参数和同质假设来近似信道统计，无法准确表征空间异构的隐蔽环境。本文旨在通过显式建模每个用户的几何位置和信道方差，更精确地分析空间异构环境下的隐蔽通信性能。
AI.method: 1. 显式建模每个用户的几何位置及对应的用户到Willie和用户到Bob信道方差；2. 数学证明广义开关功率控制方案（联合考虑Bob和Willie信道）是异构用户配置下的最优传输策略；3. 基于最优策略推导最小检测错误概率和满足隐蔽约束所需最小协作用户数的闭式表达式；4. 提出分段搜索算法以显著降低计算复杂度实现精确最优性。
AI.result: 1. 获得闭式表达式，通过蒙特卡洛仿真验证理论分析；2. 发现用户空间异构性可以增强隐蔽通信性能；3. 考虑用户空间异构性的优化相比基于空间同质假设的优化能显著提升隐蔽通信性能。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过精确建模空间异构环境，证明了广义开关功率控制方案的最优性，推导了关键性能指标的闭式表达式，并提出高效优化算法。研究发现用户空间异构性实际上有利于隐蔽通信，这为实际系统设计提供了重要指导。

title: Challenge-Response Authentication for LEO Satellite Channels: Exploiting Orbit-Specific Uniqueness
summary: The number of low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite constellations has grown rapidly in recent years, bringing a major change to global wireless communications. As LEO satellite links take on a growing role in critical services such as emergency communications, navigation, wide-area data collection, and military operations, keeping these links secure has become an important concern. In particular, verifying the identity of a satellite transmitter is now a basic requirement for protecting the services that rely on satellite access. In this article, we propose an active challenge-response authentication framework in which the verifier checks the satellite at randomly chosen times that are not known in advance, removing the fixed measurement window that existing passive methods expose to adversaries. The proposed framework uses the deterministic yet unpredictably sampled nature of orbital observables to establish a physics based root of trust for satellite identity authentication. This approach transforms satellite authentication from static feature matching into a spatiotemporal consistency verification problem inherently constrained by orbital dynamics, providing robust protection even against trajectory-aware spoofing attacks.

AI.tldr: 提出一种主动挑战-响应认证框架，通过随机时间验证卫星身份，消除固定测量窗口，利用轨道观测的确定性但不可预测采样特性建立基于物理的信任根。
AI.motivation: 随着低地球轨道卫星星座的快速增长，卫星链路在紧急通信、导航、广域数据收集和军事行动等关键服务中的作用日益重要。保护这些链路安全、验证卫星发射器身份已成为基本需求，现有被动方法存在固定测量窗口易受攻击的问题。
AI.method: 提出主动挑战-响应认证框架，验证者在随机选择的时间（提前未知）检查卫星，消除固定测量窗口。利用轨道观测的确定性但不可预测采样特性，建立基于物理的信任根，将卫星认证从静态特征匹配转化为受轨道动力学约束的时空一致性验证问题。
AI.result: 该方法能够提供强大的保护，即使对抗轨迹感知的欺骗攻击也有效，通过物理约束的轨道动力学实现可靠的卫星身份认证。
AI.conclusion: 提出的主动认证框架通过随机时间验证和轨道物理约束，为卫星身份认证提供了更安全可靠的解决方案，特别适用于对抗高级欺骗攻击的场景。

title: Contrastive Learning Boosts Deterministic and Generative Models for Weather Data
summary:
Weather data, comprising multiple variables, poses significant challenges due to its high dimensionality and multimodal nature. Creating low-dimensional embeddings requires compressing this data into a compact, shared latent space. This compression is required to improve the efficiency and performance of downstream tasks, such as forecasting or extreme-weather detection.
  Self-supervised learning, particularly contrastive learning, offers a way to generate low-dimensional, robust embeddings from unlabelled data, enabling downstream tasks when labelled data is scarce. Despite initial exploration of contrastive learning in weather data, particularly with the ERA5 dataset, the current literature does not extensively examine its benefits relative to alternative compression methods, notably autoencoders. Moreover, current work on contrastive learning does not investigate how these models can incorporate sparse data, which is more common in real-world data collection. It is critical to explore and understand how contrastive learning contributes to creating more robust embeddings for sparse weather data, thereby improving performance on downstream tasks.
  Our work extensively explores contrastive learning on the ERA5 dataset, aligning sparse samples with complete ones via a contrastive loss term to create SPARse-data augmented conTRAstive spatiotemporal embeddings (SPARTA). We introduce a temporally aware batch sampling strategy and a cycle-consistency loss to improve the structure of the latent space. Furthermore, we propose a novel graph neural network fusion technique to inject domain-specific physical knowledge. Ultimately, our results demonstrate that contrastive learning is a feasible and advantageous compression method for sparse geoscience data, thereby enhancing performance in downstream tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出SPARTA方法，通过对比学习为稀疏天气数据创建鲁棒嵌入，结合时间感知采样、循环一致性损失和图神经网络融合物理知识，提升下游任务性能。
AI.motivation: 天气数据具有高维度和多模态特性，需要压缩到紧凑共享潜在空间以提高下游任务效率。现有对比学习研究未充分比较其与自编码器等压缩方法的优势，也未探索如何处理稀疏数据（实际数据收集更常见）。
AI.method: 提出SPARTA方法：1）通过对比损失将稀疏样本与完整样本对齐；2）时间感知批次采样策略；3）循环一致性损失改善潜在空间结构；4）图神经网络融合技术注入领域特定物理知识。
AI.result: 证明对比学习是稀疏地球科学数据可行且有利的压缩方法，能够增强下游任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 对比学习为稀疏天气数据创建鲁棒嵌入提供了有效途径，结合领域知识注入和结构化损失函数，显著提升压缩表示的质量和下游任务表现。

title: Intelligent Reflection as a Service (IRaaS): System Architecture, Enabling Technologies, and Deployment Strategy
summary: Reflecting intelligent surface (RIS) is a promising technology for 6G mobile communications. However, identifying the niche of RIS within the mobile networks is a challenging task. To mitigate the escalating system complexity of mobile networks, we propose the concept of Intelligent Reflection as a Service (IRaaS), and discuss its system architecture, enabling technologies, and deployment strategy, respectively. By leveraging technologies such as resource pooling, service based architecture (SBA), cloud infrastructure, and model-free signal processing, IRaaS empowers telecom operators to deliver on-demand intelligent reflection services without a radical update of current communication protocols. In addition, IRaaS brings a novel deployment strategy that creates new opportunities for the vendors of intelligent reflection service and balances the interests of both telecom operators and property owners. IRaaS is expected to speed up the rollout of RIS from both technical perspective and commercial perspective, fostering an authentic smart radio environment for future mobile communications.

AI.tldr: 论文提出智能反射即服务(IRaaS)概念，旨在解决RIS在移动网络中定位困难的问题，通过资源池化、云基础设施等技术降低系统复杂度，加速RIS部署。
AI.motivation: RIS是6G移动通信的有前景技术，但在移动网络中确定其定位位置面临挑战。为了缓解移动网络日益增长的系统复杂度，需要新的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出IRaaS概念，采用资源池化、基于服务的架构(SBA)、云基础设施和无模型信号处理等技术，使电信运营商能够按需提供智能反射服务，无需大幅更新现有通信协议。
AI.result: IRaaS提供了一种新颖的部署策略，为智能反射服务供应商创造新机会，平衡电信运营商和物业所有者的利益，有望从技术和商业角度加速RIS的推广。
AI.conclusion: IRaaS有望加速RIS的部署，为未来移动通信培育真正的智能无线电环境，从技术和商业角度促进6G网络发展。

title: Grokking as a Falsifiable Finite-Size Transition
summary: Grokking -- the delayed onset of generalization after early memorization -- is often described with phase-transition language, but that claim has lacked falsifiable finite-size inputs. Here we supply those inputs by treating the group order $p$ of $\mathbb{Z}_p$ as an admissible extensive variable and a held-out spectral head-tail contrast as a representation-level order parameter, then apply a condensed-matter-style diagnostic chain to coarse-grid sweeps and a dense near-critical addition audit. Binder-like crossings reveal a shared finite-size boundary, and susceptibility comparison strongly disfavors a smooth-crossover interpretation ($Δ\mathrm{AIC}=16.8$ in the near-critical audit). Phase-transition language in grokking can therefore be tested as a quantitative finite-size claim rather than invoked as analogy alone, although the transition order remains unresolved at present.

AI.tldr: 该研究为深度学习中"顿悟"现象的相变描述提供了可检验的有限尺寸输入，通过将群阶p作为扩展变量，使用谱头尾对比作为序参量，应用凝聚态物理诊断方法证实了相变而非平滑交叉的解释。
AI.motivation: 深度学习中的"顿悟"现象（延迟泛化）常被类比为相变，但缺乏可检验的有限尺寸输入和定量验证。本研究旨在为这种相变描述提供可证伪的定量基础，而非仅仅停留在类比层面。
AI.method: 将群阶p作为可接受的扩展变量，使用保留的谱头尾对比作为表示层面的序参量，应用凝聚态物理风格的诊断链：包括粗网格扫描和密集近临界加法审计，使用类似Binder交叉的方法分析有限尺寸边界。
AI.result: Binder-like交叉揭示了共享的有限尺寸边界，敏感性比较强烈反对平滑交叉解释（在近临界审计中ΔAIC=16.8）。这表明"顿悟"中的相变语言可以作为定量有限尺寸主张进行检验。
AI.conclusion: "顿悟"现象的相变描述可以从单纯的类比提升为可定量检验的有限尺寸主张，尽管目前相变阶数仍未解决。这为深度学习中的相变研究提供了新的方法论基础。

title: A Ray-Based Characterization of Satellite-to-Urban Propagation
summary: The evolution toward 6G communication systems is expected to rely on integrated three-dimensional network architectures where terrestrial infrastructures coexist with non-terrestrial stations such as satellites, enabling ubiquitous connectivity and service continuity. In this context, accurate channel models for satellite-to-ground propagation in urban environments are essential, particularly for user equipment located at street level where obstruction and multipath effects are significant. This work investigates satellite-to-urban propagation through deterministic ray-tracing simulations. Three representative urban layouts are considered, namely dense urban, urban, and suburban. Multiple use cases are investigated, including handheld devices, vehicular terminals, and fixed rooftop receivers operating across several frequency bands. The analysis focuses on the relative importance of competing propagation mechanisms and on two key channel parameters, namely the Rician K-factor and the delay spread, which are relevant for the calibration of channel models to be used in link- and system-level simulations. Results highlight the strong - and in some cases unconventional - dependence of channel dispersion and fading characteristics on satellite elevation, antenna placement, and urban morphology.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过确定性射线追踪模拟分析了卫星到城市传播信道，重点关注不同城市布局、终端类型和频段下的传播机制、莱斯K因子和时延扩展特性。
AI.motivation: 随着6G通信系统向三维网络架构演进，卫星与地面基础设施的融合需要准确的城市环境卫星到地面传播信道模型，特别是在街道层面存在显著遮挡和多径效应的情况下。
AI.method: 采用确定性射线追踪模拟方法，考虑三种代表性城市布局（密集城市、城市、郊区），分析手持设备、车载终端和固定屋顶接收机等多种用例在不同频段下的传播特性。
AI.result: 研究发现信道色散和衰落特性对卫星仰角、天线位置和城市形态有强烈且有时非传统的影响，这些结果可用于链路级和系统级仿真的信道模型校准。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为6G三维网络架构中的卫星到城市传播提供了重要的信道特性分析，强调了考虑卫星仰角、天线位置和城市形态对信道参数影响的必要性。

title: Light Cones For Vision: Simple Causal Priors For Visual Hierarchy
summary: Standard vision models treat objects as independent points in Euclidean space, unable to capture hierarchical structure like parts within wholes. We introduce Worldline Slot Attention, which models objects as persistent trajectories through spacetime worldlines, where each object has multiple slots at different hierarchy levels sharing the same spatial position but differing in temporal coordinates. This architecture consistently fails without geometric structure: Euclidean worldlines achieve 0.078 level accuracy, below random chance (0.33), while Lorentzian worldlines achieve 0.479-0.661 across three datasets: a 6x improvement replicated over 20+ independent runs. Lorentzian geometry also outperforms hyperbolic embeddings showing visual hierarchies require causal structure (temporal dependency) rather than tree structure (radial branching). Our results demonstrate that hierarchical object discovery requires geometric structure encoding asymmetric causality, an inductive bias absent from Euclidean space but natural to Lorentzian light cones, achieved with only 11K parameters. The code is available at: https://github.com/iclrsubmissiongram/loco.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Worldline Slot Attention，将物体建模为时空世界线中的持久轨迹，使用洛伦兹几何而非欧几里得几何，在层次物体发现任务上实现6倍性能提升
AI.motivation: 标准视觉模型将物体视为欧几里得空间中的独立点，无法捕捉层次结构（如部分与整体的关系）。需要一种能够编码层次结构的几何表示
AI.method: 引入Worldline Slot Attention，将物体建模为时空世界线中的持久轨迹，每个物体在不同层次级别有多个槽位，共享空间位置但具有不同的时间坐标。比较欧几里得和洛伦兹几何结构
AI.result: 欧几里得世界线准确率仅0.078（低于随机机会0.33），而洛伦兹世界线在三个数据集上达到0.479-0.661，性能提升6倍。洛伦兹几何优于双曲嵌入，表明视觉层次需要因果结构而非树结构
AI.conclusion: 层次物体发现需要编码非对称因果关系的几何结构，这是欧几里得空间缺乏但洛伦兹光锥自然具备的归纳偏置。仅用11K参数即可实现

title: Transformers in the Dark: Navigating Unknown Search Spaces via Bandit Feedback
comment: Accepted for publication in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR)
summary: Effective problem solving with Large Language Models (LLMs) can be enhanced when they are paired with external search algorithms. By viewing the space of diverse ideas and their follow-up possibilities as a tree structure, the search algorithm can navigate such a search space and guide the LLM toward better solutions more efficiently. While the search algorithm enables an effective balance between exploitation and exploration of a tree-structured space, the need for an external component can complicate the overall problem-solving process. We therefore pose the following question: Can LLMs or their underlying Transformer architectures approximate a search algorithm? To answer this question, we first introduce a simplified framework in which tree extensions and feedback signals are externally specified, allowing for controlled evaluation of search capabilities. We call this setting unknown tree search with bandit feedback. Within this setting, we show that Transformers are theoretically expressive enough to implement distinct search strategies and can be trained from scratch to approximate those strategies. Our Transformer models exhibit the possibility of generalizing to unseen conditions such as longer horizons or deeper trees. Furthermore, we demonstrate that continued task-focused training unlocks the complete capabilities of a pretrained LLM, by fine-tuning the LLM on search trajectories.

AI.tldr: 研究表明Transformer架构理论上能够近似搜索算法，通过训练可以实现不同搜索策略，并能泛化到未见过的条件，任务导向的持续训练可以解锁预训练LLM的完整搜索能力。
AI.motivation: 虽然外部搜索算法能增强LLM的问题解决能力，但需要额外组件会使整体流程复杂化。因此研究探索LLM或其底层Transformer架构是否能够近似搜索算法，从而简化问题解决过程。
AI.method: 引入一个简化框架：未知树搜索与赌博机反馈，其中树扩展和反馈信号由外部指定。在此设置下，从零开始训练Transformer模型来近似不同的搜索策略，并通过任务导向的持续训练微调预训练LLM。
AI.result: Transformer在理论上具有足够的表达能力来实现不同的搜索策略，能够泛化到更长视野或更深树等未见条件。任务导向的持续训练可以解锁预训练LLM的完整搜索能力。
AI.conclusion: LLM的Transformer架构能够近似搜索算法，这为简化问题解决流程提供了可能，通过适当的训练可以使LLM具备搜索能力而无需外部组件。

title: Local learning for stable backpropagation-free neural network training towards physical learning
summary: While backpropagation and automatic differentiation have driven deep learning's success, the physical limits of chip manufacturing and rising environmental costs of deep learning motivate alternative learning paradigms such as physical neural networks. However, most existing physical neural networks still rely on digital computing for training, largely because backpropagation and automatic differentiation are difficult to realize in physical systems. We introduce FFzero, a forward-only learning framework enabling stable neural network training without backpropagation or automatic differentiation. FFzero combines layer-wise local learning, prototype-based representations, and directional-derivative-based optimization through forward evaluations only. We show that local learning is effective under forward-only optimization, where backpropagation fails. FFzero generalizes to multilayer perceptron and convolutional neural networks across classification and regression. Using a simulated photonic neural network as an example, we demonstrate that FFzero provides a viable path toward backpropagation-free in-situ physical learning.

AI.tldr: FFzero是一个仅使用前向传播的深度学习框架，无需反向传播或自动微分，通过层间局部学习、原型表示和基于方向导数的优化实现稳定训练。
AI.motivation: 芯片制造的物理限制和深度学习的环境成本推动了对物理神经网络等替代学习范式的需求，但现有物理神经网络仍依赖数字计算进行训练，因为反向传播和自动微分在物理系统中难以实现。
AI.method: FFzero结合了层间局部学习、原型表示和仅通过前向评估实现的方向导数优化，无需反向传播或自动微分。
AI.result: FFzero在多层感知机和卷积神经网络上对分类和回归任务具有良好泛化能力，在模拟光子神经网络中展示了无需反向传播的物理原位学习可行性。
AI.conclusion: FFzero为无需反向传播的物理原位学习提供了可行路径，展示了前向优化下局部学习的有效性，而反向传播在此场景下会失败。

title: A Practical Guide Towards Interpreting Time-Series Deep Clinical Predictive Models: A Reproducibility Study
summary: Clinical decisions are high-stakes and require explicit justification, making model interpretability essential for auditing deep clinical models prior to deployment. As the ecosystem of model architectures and explainability methods expands, critical questions remain: Do architectural features like attention improve explainability? Do interpretability approaches generalize across clinical tasks? While prior benchmarking efforts exist, they often lack extensibility and reproducibility, and critically, fail to systematically examine how interpretability varies across the interplay of clinical tasks and model architectures. To address these gaps, we present a comprehensive benchmark evaluating interpretability methods across diverse clinical prediction tasks and model architectures. Our analysis reveals that: (1) attention when leveraged properly is a highly efficient approach for faithfully interpreting model predictions; (2) black-box interpreters like KernelSHAP and LIME are computationally infeasible for time-series clinical prediction tasks; and (3) several interpretability approaches are too unreliable to be trustworthy. From our findings, we discuss several guidelines on improving interpretability within clinical predictive pipelines. To support reproducibility and extensibility, we provide our implementations via PyHealth, a well-documented open-source framework: https://github.com/sunlabuiuc/PyHealth.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个评估临床预测任务中可解释性方法的综合基准，发现注意力机制在正确使用时是高效的解释方法，而黑盒解释器在时间序列任务中计算不可行，许多方法可靠性不足。
AI.motivation: 临床决策需要明确的可解释性来审计深度模型，但现有基准缺乏可扩展性和可重复性，未能系统研究临床任务和模型架构对可解释性的影响。
AI.method: 开发了一个综合基准，在多样化的临床预测任务和模型架构上评估多种可解释性方法，并通过PyHealth开源框架提供实现。
AI.result: 发现：(1) 正确使用的注意力机制是高效的解释方法；(2) KernelSHAP和LIME等黑盒解释器在时间序列临床预测任务中计算不可行；(3) 多种可解释性方法可靠性不足。
AI.conclusion: 提出了改进临床预测流程中可解释性的指导原则，并通过开源框架PyHealth支持研究的可重复性和可扩展性。

title: Flow matching on homogeneous spaces
summary: We propose a general framework to extend Flow Matching to homogeneous spaces, i.e. quotients of Lie groups. Our approach reformulates the problem as a flow matching task on the underlying Lie group by lifting the data distributions. This strategy avoids the potentially complicated geometry of homogeneous spaces by working directly on Lie groups, which in turn enables us reduce the problem to a Euclidean flow matching task on Lie algebras. In contrast to Riemannian Flow Matching, our method eliminates the need to define and compute premetrics or geodesics, resulting in a simpler, faster, and fully intrinsic framework.

AI.tldr: 提出将流匹配扩展到齐次空间（李群商空间）的通用框架，通过将数据分布提升到李群上，将问题转化为李代数上的欧几里得流匹配任务，简化了计算并避免了复杂几何。
AI.motivation: 齐次空间（李群的商空间）在机器学习中很重要，但现有的黎曼流匹配方法需要定义和计算预度量或测地线，计算复杂且受限于特定几何结构。
AI.method: 通过将齐次空间上的数据分布提升到基础李群上，将流匹配任务转化为李群上的问题，然后进一步简化为李代数上的欧几里得流匹配，避免了直接处理齐次空间的复杂几何。
AI.result: 该方法比黎曼流匹配更简单、更快，且完全内蕴（intrinsic），无需定义预度量或计算测地线，为齐次空间上的生成建模提供了更高效的框架。
AI.conclusion: 提出的框架成功将流匹配扩展到齐次空间，通过李群提升策略简化了几何复杂性，为在更广泛的几何结构上进行生成建模提供了实用且高效的方法。

title: Reaching Beyond the Mode: RL for Distributional Reasoning in Language Models
summary: Given a question, a language model (LM) implicitly encodes a distribution over possible answers. In practice, post-training procedures for LMs often collapse this distribution onto a single dominant mode. While this is generally not a problem for benchmark-style evaluations that assume one correct answer, many real-world tasks inherently involve multiple valid answers or irreducible uncertainty. Examples include medical diagnosis, ambiguous question answering, and settings with incomplete information. In these cases, we would like LMs to generate multiple plausible hypotheses, ideally with confidence estimates for each one, and without computationally intensive repeated sampling to generate non-modal answers. This paper describes a multi-answer reinforcement learning approach for training LMs to perform distributional reasoning over multiple answers during inference. We modify the RL objective to enable models to explicitly generate multiple candidate answers in a single forward pass, internalizing aspects of inference-time search into the model's generative process. Across question-answering, medical diagnostic, and coding benchmarks, we observe improved diversity, coverage, and set-level calibration scores compared to single answer trained baselines. Models trained with our approach require fewer tokens to generate multiple answers than competing approaches. On coding tasks, they are also substantially more accurate. These results position multi-answer RL as a principled and compute-efficient alternative to inference-time scaling procedures such as best-of-k. Code and more information can be found at https://multi-answer-rl.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 多答案强化学习训练语言模型在单次前向传播中生成多个候选答案，提高多样性、覆盖率和集合级校准，减少生成多个答案所需的计算成本。
AI.motivation: 现实世界任务（如医疗诊断、模糊问答）通常存在多个有效答案或不可约的不确定性，但现有语言模型训练方法往往将答案分布坍缩到单一主导模式，无法有效处理多答案场景。
AI.method: 提出多答案强化学习方法，修改RL目标使模型在单次前向传播中显式生成多个候选答案，将推理时搜索的某些方面内化到模型的生成过程中。
AI.result: 在问答、医疗诊断和编程基准测试中，相比单答案训练基线，实现了更好的多样性、覆盖率和集合级校准分数；生成多个答案所需token更少；在编程任务中准确性显著提高。
AI.conclusion: 多答案RL是推理时扩展程序（如best-of-k）的原则性和计算高效替代方案，能够使语言模型在不确定场景下进行分布推理。

title: Learning to Staff: Offline Reinforcement Learning and Fine-Tuned LLMs for Warehouse Staffing Optimization
comment: ICLR 2026 Workshop on AI for Mechanism Design and Strategic Decision Making
summary: We investigate machine learning approaches for optimizing real-time staffing decisions in semi-automated warehouse sortation systems.
